note: P4345 (Pro 29:12) — if a ruler listens to falsehood, all his officials become wicked.

dims.v: corrupting credulity — a ruler who listens to lies breeds a wicked court
the listening of a ruler to falsehood — the credulity or complicity at the top that corrupts the whole administration, since officials become what the ruler rewards
the wickedness it breeds in officials (266775)
welded to the corrupt servants his credulity produces

qashab (attend/listen) — 'if a ruler LISTENS to falsehood, all his officials will be wicked'; a leader who heeds lies breeds liars — the whole court takes its character from what the ruler will hear. Corruption flows down from the top.
institutional corruption — the servants a lie-heeding ruler breeds
the wickedness of all a ruler's officials when he listens to falsehood — the institutional corruption that follows a corrupt or credulous head, servants shaped to match the master's ear
the ruler's credulity that breeds it (266770)
welded to the lie-heeding rule that produces it
rasha — 'all his OFFICIALS will be wicked'; a court takes its character from its ruler. Where the head heeds lies, the whole body turns corrupt. Leadership shapes the institution.
